name: Aqara Smart Lock U200 (EU)

radios.note: CSA lists Thread and Bluetooth. Aqara's spec sheet also lists NFC for cards and phones.

matter.note: CSA lists the Smart Lock U200 from Lumi United (Aqara), product ID 0x2802, with Thread and Bluetooth. The listing does not name a region; a separate US model (AD075) has its own certificate.

apple_home.note: Needs an Apple home hub that is a Thread border router (HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen, Apple TV 4K).

google_home.note: Needs a Thread border router that supports Matter.

alexa.note: Needs a Thread border router that supports Matter.

smartthings.note: Needs a Thread border router that supports Matter.

home_assistant.note: Aqara's launch release lists Home Assistant; reached through Matter, which needs a Thread border router. Aqara's manual says third-party platforms get only basic functions.

hubRequired.note: Aqara disagrees with itself: the US spec table says a hub is required (Aqara M3), while the U200 FAQ says Aqara Home users need no hub and the M3 is only needed for remote control and automations.

localControl.note: No Aqara source states local-only control.

lockFit.note: Aqara calls it a retrofit lock: it mounts on the inside over the existing cylinder. Euro-profile cylinders need an emergency function; Aqara's installation page covers the supported cylinder types.

keypad.note: The lock ships with a pre-paired wireless outdoor keypad with fingerprint reader (4 × AAA or 12-24 V wired); the EU box lists the four AAA batteries for it.

power.note: 7.4 V rechargeable Li-ion pack, included in the EU box; up to about 6 months per charge at 8 unlocks a day. Aqara's spec also allows 4 AA cells through an AA battery adaptor, which the EU box list does not include.

summary: Aqara Smart Lock U200 is a retrofit lock that mounts on the inside over your existing cylinder and joins Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant over Matter on Thread. Every platform needs a Thread border router; for Apple that means a HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen or Apple TV 4K. The kit includes a wireless outdoor keypad with fingerprint reader, and the lock runs on a rechargeable 7.4 V Li-ion pack rated at about 6 months per charge.
caveats: Matter needs a Thread border router; on Apple Home it must be a HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen or Apple TV 4K.
Aqara's manual says third-party platforms get only basic functions.
Aqara contradicts itself on whether a hub (Aqara M3) is required; its FAQ says the M3 is only needed for remote control and automations.
Euro-profile cylinders need an emergency function to keep using your key from outside.
The US model (AD075) is a separate product with its own Matter certificate.
